handlingUnit.description: The packaging level a standard is declared for, and that a completed task handled (ADR 0035). INNER is deliberately absent: no flow implements it in v1.
handlingUnit.title: HandlingUnit

travelComponentSeconds.description: Optional declaration of how much of expectedSeconds is attributable to travel between locations for this TaskType. This service never computes it: it is supplied by the caller, grounded in a real distance estimate performed elsewhere (e.g. facility-layout's estimate_travel_distance) since this service has no REST dependency in either direction with any sibling context (ADR 0015). Omitted entirely means not broken out, the default and most common case. When present, must be between 0 and expectedSeconds inclusive.
travelComponentSeconds.title: TravelComponentSeconds

allOf.description: The declared heavy-case rule of a CASE standard: a case heavier than thresholdG grams needs two operators and is scored against expectedSeconds instead of the standard's own. Declarative input; this service never looks a case weight up from a sibling context.

thresholdG.description: Weight in grams ABOVE which a case needs a team lift (a case weighing exactly thresholdG is still a one-operator lift).

expectedSeconds.description: Engineered elapsed seconds of a team lift.

allOf.title: TeamLiftRequest

effectiveTo.description: Present only on a superseded (closed) standard.

caseStandard.summary: ?handlingUnit=CASE with a CASE standard and a team lift

fallsBack.summary: ?handlingUnit=EACH with no EACH standard falls back

400.description: Unknown task type or unknown handling unit
